messages:
Connor (AE): Heads-up: HelionWorks CISO just paused our POC. They need a concise exec summary + network runbook proving no uncontrolled outbound egress and 90-day audit export. Deadline: Mon EOD for their board review.
Leah (SE): Understood. Quick Q: are they asking for Dedicated/Private or would Hosted + retention + reserved egress IPs be acceptable?
Connor (AE): Their questionnaire implies Dedicated will be preferred but theysaid they're open to a hosted path if we can show deterministic egress IPs + exportable logs and a rollback plan.
Nia (Security): TL;DR: Hosted can provide per-request logging and sample export but retention >31 days requires the retention addon. We do not enforce per-tenant outbound FQDN blocking on hosted - that requires network isolation (Dedicated/Private) or customer-side egress proxy.
Diego (Infra): We can reserve static NAT egress IPs for a tenant via INFRA-8240. That gives them a fixed set of source IPs to allow inbound. For outbound blocking we'd need Dedicated.
Marta (Legal): The CISO also asked for plain-language liability wording for the POC. I'll draft a short paragraph that states responsibilities during the POC and suggested acceptance criteria.
Leah (SE): I'll assemble a one-page runbook + 2-paragraph exec note: sections: 1) quick summary and tradeoffs 2) inbound allowlist (example CIDRs) 3) outbound constraints 4) log export steps 5) emergency rollback. Will include sample curl checks and log-export URL.
Connor (AE): Please include pricing delta: Dedicated delta and retention addon cost. I want to show both options to the prospect. Nia, can you confirm acceptance criteria the CISO will want to tick off?
Nia (Security): Acceptance checklist I recommend: ["Reserved NAT IPs verified", "90d log export test passed (sample CSV)", "Blocked-host egress test produces logged event", "Rollback tested and documented"]. I'll put that in the exec note.
Diego (Infra): infra-bot: open INFRA-8240 and schedule an ops window to reserve NAT IPs for tenant-helionworks.
infra-bot: Created INFRA-8240: Reserve static NAT IPs for tenant-helionworks and generate ACL template. Assigned to infra-scheduling.
Leah (SE): Runbook snippet draft: ```
Inbound allowlist (examples): 15.197.45.0/24, 44.210.9.0/24
Steps:
- Confirm INFRA-8240 reserved IPs
- Customer adds inbound allowlist to firewall
- Launch egress validation: `python egress_test.py --target blocked-domain.test`
- Export logs: /admin/logs/export?tenant=helionworks&range=90d
Rollback:
- Revert ACLs to previous commit hash `a1b2c3`
- Re-route traffic to stable-model-pool
- Notify infra oncall and customer SRE
```
Marta (Legal): Drafted liability blurb: "During the POC, Redwood will provide the network controls described. Customer accepts responsibility for actions initiated by POC workloads; both parties will validate egress behavior as part of acceptance criteria." Will run by counsel.
Connor (AE): Timeline: can we deliver runbook + exec note + INFRA-8240 link by Mon 10:00am so I can prep their board packet?
Diego (Infra): If INFRA-8240 is prioritized today, we can reserve IPs by Sun evening. Otherwise Mon morning. I'll ping infra-scheduling.
Leah (SE): I'll post the full one-pager and exec note here by Sun evening.
Nia (Security): Posting suggested acceptance checklist and CISO wording now.
Marta (Legal): I'll finish the legal paragraph and attach counsel-approved wording once reviewed.
Connor (AE): Thanks team. This is high priority for the deal. Please drop final artifacts here; I'll bundle and send to the CISO once everything's attached. :pray:
